memory: I keep τ constant and sternum clamp set to 1.5 turns. Pelvic micro-rotation remains the dominant delay source. Previously 33 N was operational minimum; with a re-seat-after-each-push protocol I achieved five consecutive T≤1.75 at 31 N. Re-seating eliminates seating drift that otherwise increases initiation time. Tradeoffs: added inter-trial pause and minor skin marking. Current position: 31 N viable only with active clamp maintenance. Next I must find the minimal re-seating frequency that preserves performance without full per-trial intervention.
